title: 6 AI character replacement tools for video (2026)
summary: Compare six current AI character replacement workflows: Magic Hour, Viggle, Higgsfield, Runway, Luma and Pika. See inputs, limits and evaluation steps.
body_markdown:
Quick Answer


## Quick answer


To replace a person or character in existing footage, start with[Magic Hour Character Replace](https://magichour.ai/products/character-replace) and a clear replacement reference. Compare it with Viggle Mix, Higgsfield Recast, Runway Edit Studio, Luma Ray3 Modify and Pika Pikaswaps using the same source clip. A face swap changes facial identity; character replacement changes more of the subject.


## **Character Replace vs Character Animation vs Face Swap: Know the Difference First**


Before choosing a tool, it helps to define what you actually want to change.


**Tool Type**


**What It Does**


**Best For**


[Character Replace](https://magichour.ai/products/character-replace)


Replaces the full person in existing video with a reference image while keeping the original motion


Swapping actors, ad localization, mascot content


[Character Animation](https://magichour.ai/products/animation)


Takes a still image and makes it perform movements from a reference video


Animating a character that does not exist in video form yet


[Face Swap Only](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap/video)


Changes the face in a video while keeping the original hair and body


Quick face swaps without full character transformation


This article focuses on replacing the character already in your footage. If only facial identity needs to change, use a[video face swap](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap/video) . Several platforms support both animation and replacement; compare the selected mode, not just the product name.


### Replace a character in your own video


Upload a clip and a clear reference image to Magic Hour, then review a short section before processing the full video.


[Try Character Replace](https://magichour.ai/products/character-replace)

**Start with Magic Hour** if you want to test full character replacement in a browser without creating an account. For a production choice, compare one representative shot against the closest alternative and judge the downloaded file. This shortlist compares documented workflows, not results from a controlled quality benchmark.


## **The 6 Best AI Character Replace Tools**


### **1. Magic Hour**


**Best for:** Free browser-based character replacement with no sign-up


[Magic Hour Character Replace](https://magichour.ai/products/character-replace) uses a source video and replacement image to change the main subject. It supports realistic and stylized references. The current interface exposes **Replace** and **Animate** options; choose the mode that retains the source shot when that is the goal.


A useful shortcut is the built-in preset gallery, which includes characters such as Peter Griffin, Kratos, Elmo, Deadpool, Chun-Li, and the Grinch, making it easy to test the workflow without preparing a reference image. The main limitation is that difficult footage—especially heavy motion blur, occlusion, or fast cuts—can still introduce flicker or character drift.


Creator: $12/month billed annually ($144/year), or $19 on monthly billing. Pro: $25/month billed annually ($300/year), or $39 monthly. Business: $66/month billed annually ($792/year), or $99 monthly.[Current pricing](https://magichour.ai/pricing) . Credit use depends on the tool, model, duration and output settings. Paid subscriptions include commercial use and watermark-free exports; check the current pricing page before choosing a plan.


For a recurring spokesperson or mascot, use a consistent reference rather than inventing the character again for each clip. The[character-consistency guide](https://magichour.ai/blog/best-ai-image-generators-for-character-consistency) explains how to prepare and reuse those references. Then review each replacement through turns, hand movements and occlusion.


### **2. Higgsfield Recast**


Official workflow:[Higgsfield Recast](https://higgsfield.ai/app/recast) .


Best fit: Browser-based full-character replacement from a source video and reference image.


Higgsfield's[Recast workflow](https://higgsfield.ai/app/recast) accepts a video containing the subject and an image of the replacement character. Its current product page distinguishes this from a face-only swap and routes the result into the wider Higgsfield studio.


Evaluate the complete output for body shape, face, clothing, pose, motion, occlusion, background and audio. The provider's selected examples and marketing claims do not establish a success rate for your footage.


Access and pricing: Recast uses the Higgsfield account and credit system. Check the current generation quote and[plan rules](https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/plans/how-do-higgsfield-plans-work) before committing a batch.


### **3. Viggle AI**


**Best fit:** character replacement, multi-character swaps and motion-reference workflows.


[Viggle Mix](https://viggle.ai/blog/viggle-ai-the-ultimate-guide) replaces a character in a video using an image reference. Motion Control, formerly Move, animates a still character from a motion reference. Multi and Editor add multi-character and selection/tracking workflows. Viggle therefore belongs in this replacement comparison, not just a separate animation category.


You can provide a character image and a video, and Viggle maps the character's appearance onto the video's movement. Its current body-swap page says it supports full face-and-body replacement, anime, 2D, 3D, and cartoon characters, as well as multi-person swaps.


For one subject, compare Mix with Magic Hour’s replacement workflow using the same source. For several subjects, examine the selection and tracking controls before generating. Do not assume that a tool is unsuitable for an existing production shot simply because it also provides meme templates.


[Viggle pricing](https://viggle.ai/pricing) lists five free videos per day after sign-up. Its face-swap FAQ additionally advertises a guest trial and watermark-free swaps, while the general plan comparison lists watermark removal as paid. Check the selected workflow’s actual export; those pages do not establish a universal free watermark rule.


### **4. Runway Edit Studio**


Official workflow:[Runway Edit Studio](https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/51683104370451-Creating-with-Edit-Studio) .


Best fit: Prompt- and keyframe-guided replacement inside a broader video editing platform.


Runway's[Edit Studio](https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/51683104370451-Creating-with-Edit-Studio) uses Aleph 2.0 to edit existing footage. The current guide explicitly includes replacing characters and products across single- or multi-shot sequences up to 30 seconds.


Use a keyframe when the replacement's appearance must be explicit, then state what should change and what should remain. Review the surrounding scene after every edit; an instruction to preserve it is not proof that every detail stayed fixed.


Access and pricing: feature access and credit cost depend on the current Runway plan, model and clip. Confirm the calculated charge before generating.


### **5. Luma Ray3 Modify**


Official workflow:[Luma Ray3 Modify](https://lumalabs.ai/learning-hub/ray3-modify-user-guide) .


Best fit: Character-guided modification when an input video should continue to supply motion and scene structure.


Luma's[Ray3 Modify guide](https://lumalabs.ai/learning-hub/ray3-modify-user-guide) documents character-reference workflows that combine a source video with a character image. Modify strength changes how closely the result follows the source shapes and motion.


Use a clear, unobstructed character reference and test Modify strength on the actual shot. Review identity, pose, hands, edges, lighting, background and any object interaction through the complete clip.


Access and pricing: Dream Machine plans and credits vary by model and operation. Check the selected Modify workflow and current pricing rather than applying a general Luma allowance.


### **6. Pika Pikaswaps**


Official workflow:[Pika Pikaswaps](https://pika.art/faq) .


Best fit: Replacing a selected subject or object in a short source video.


Pika describes[Pikaswaps](https://pika.art/faq) as a video-to-video feature for changing a selected area while retaining the wider source video. It can use a text description and an optional image reference for the replacement.


Define the region or subject precisely and use the reference image when appearance matters. This is a targeted swap workflow, not a promise of full-body consistency through every pose or occlusion.


Access and pricing: current creator-plan credits vary by resolution and plan. The first-party[Pika pricing page](https://pika.art/pricing) lists Pikaswaps separately; check the live plan and commercial-use terms before a campaign.


## **Which Tool Should You Use?**


- Magic Hour: start with a no-account full-character-replacement trial.
- Viggle: compare Mix, Multi and Motion Control for one or several subjects.
- Higgsfield Recast: use a browser workflow built specifically around video plus a character image.
- Runway or Luma: evaluate a broader editing or modification workflow with keyframes and references.
- Pika Pikaswaps: target a selected subject or object in a short clip.


## **A Note on Consent and Responsible Use**


Only replace a person in a video with someone else's likeness if you have their consent or have the right to use the reference image. Avoid creating replacement content that falsely presents a real person as saying or doing something they did not actually say or do. Always check each platform's current terms before using generated content publicly or commercially.
